authorization: Reads require projects.read; writes require both for exact unit; no implicit owner access. Auditor read only. No grant bootstrap.

text_semantics.length_unit: Unicode code points, as Python len and PostgreSQL length; not UTF-16 code units or grapheme clusters
text_semantics.identity: Trim only boundary blank characters from code, name and status reason before validating length; reject empty results; retain internal whitespace.
text_semantics.notes: Preserve all note characters. For blocked/reported, require a nonempty result after checking the same boundary blank set; do not replace the stored note with that result.

step.notes: string max2000; trimmed nonempty required blocked/reported

routes.query: unit_id required UUID; limit default50 max50; offset default0
routes.response: Project[] <=limit; exact-unit read capability required, includes archived; ordered code/id
201 ProjectDetail = project fields + steps:Step[]; all steps atomically generated server-side

routes.body: expected_version positive int plus at least one of name,scope_summary,coordinator_user_id(nullable),target_date(nullable); extra keys forbidden

routes.response: ProjectDetail; actual status change only, row_version+1

routes.body: expected_project_version AND expected_version positive int; at least one of status,notes,assignee_user_id(nullable),target_date(nullable); extra keys forbidden
routes.response: ProjectDetail; step version+1 AND project version+1 atomically

constraints: Step key/id/scope/parent/position immutable and all rows match frozen journey; feature_pending status cannot change.
A reported step is NOT approved/completed/ISO compliance. No project completion endpoint or percentage.
Active same-company member assignments only; assignment never grants authority. No requirement for assignee unit assignment in first release; explain this in UI.
Active unit and actor required; scope lock serializes archiving. Parent lock serializes all metadata/status/step writes.
Archived project cannot edit steps/metadata; restore requires current capabilities/reason. No DELETE.
All mutations CSRF; audit event required same transaction. 409 stale/DBscope conflicts, 403 capability, 404 inaccessible row, 422 invalid body.
Pending catalog/UI mismatch must refuse edits rather than discard records. Reads cache:no-store/include; mutation no auto retry.
